subject: Results ledger: post-POC impact notes + quick quote and marketing permission
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@bluefield.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Results ledger: post-POC impact notes + quick quote and marketing permission

Hi Jane —

Thanks again for running the short integration POC with Redwood last week. We compiled a concise results ledger below so your team can review and (if you're comfortable) share a one-line quote we can use in a short case blurb. Nothing public until you OK it.

Quick summary (30-day POC, production-like traffic profile):
- Average inference latency: down from 210ms to 135ms (35% improvement)
- Throughput: sustained 2.1x higher under the same GPU pool
- Cost per inference (token-level): ~62% reduction after batching + KV caching enabled
- Error/fallback rate: reduced from 3.4% to 0.9% after model routing adjustments

Attached is a one-pager with the charts (20260912_bluefield-onepager.pdf).

Ask: would you be open to either: 1) a 10–15 minute quote over a quick call, or 2) a two-sentence blurb I can attribute to Bluefield Analytics (we'd include the below metrics)? Also, if you're OK, could we get marketing permission to publish the two-sentence quote and the aggregated metrics (we'll anonymize request/IDs)? If so, a signed permission PDF is great; I can send a DocuSign link.

Proposed quick quote template (feel free to edit):
"Redwood cut our inference latency by ~35% and lowered token costs by over 60%, letting us scale features without ballooning GPU spend."

If you'd like an internal draft to review before approving, I'm happy to send it. If helpful, I can also make those numbers available in a short slide for your comms team.

Best,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Attachment: 20260912_bluefield-onepager.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Jane Park <jane.park@bluefield.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@bluefield.ai>, procurement@bluefield.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Results ledger: post-POC impact notes + quick quote and marketing permission

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the clear summary and the one-pager. The internal team reviewed the numbers and we can confirm the figures you listed for our test window — very pleased with the latency and cost improvements.

I'm fine with a short quote. I tweaked your template slightly — happy to approve this exact line for marketing use: 
"Working with Redwood Inference reduced our inference latency by ~35% and lowered per-inference costs by more than 60%, enabling faster feature rollouts at lower spend."

On the marketing permission, we need our legal team to sign off on the final copy and anonymization language. Please send the DocuSign, and we'll route it internally. Expect a turnaround of 48–72 hours.

Also: one small clarification — the cost reduction number reflects batching + quantization changes applied in stage, correct? Can you add a one-sentence note I can share internally that lists the configuration used?

Thanks —
Jane
Jane Park
Head of Platform Engineering
Bluefield Analytics
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@bluefield.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Results ledger: post-POC impact notes + quick quote and marketing permission

Jane — great, really appreciate the quick review and the edited quote (we'll use exactly that).

Quick config note you can share: cost reduction measured comparing baseline (float32, no batching, no KV cache) to POC config (int8 quantization on the responder model, 128-request dynamic batching, prefix KV cache enabled for repeated session flows). That combination drove the ~62% per-inference savings in the test window. Happy to provide the config snippet if your engineers want the exact flags.

I'll start the DocuSign for marketing permission and send it your way — attaching a draft permission form that lists the attribution and anonymization scope. If legal needs edits, we'll iterate.

Vivek
Attachment: draft-marketing-permission.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Jane Park <jane.park@bluefield.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@bluefield.ai, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@bluefield.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Results ledger: post-POC impact notes + quick quote and marketing permission

Vivek —

Signed and returned via DocuSign. See attached (signed-marketing-permission.pdf). Legal asked for one edit that we confirmed — please remove the specific daily request volumes from the public asset (we prefer a percentage and relative change only). Otherwise approved.

You can go ahead and use the quote and the anonymized metrics in a short customer highlight. We'd appreciate a heads-up before anything goes live so our comms team can coordinate externally.

Thanks again for the partnership — excited to take the next steps on Dedicated capacity planning next quarter.

Best,
Jane
Attachment: signed-marketing-permission.pdf (PDF, signed)
